full_judgment: 4. The suit land was never partitioned by metes and bounds among the co-sharers. S A Khatian appears to be recorded in the names of Krishnapada, Lalit and Jhoharmoni only and there was no reason for such wrong record. Other co-sharers having declined to partition the suit land, the plaintiffs were constrained to institute the suit.
